lokele: Petelo ako Botomomu wa Yesu Masiya asotoma lokasa-lo ende bato ebasolimela amamwito l’ebasomelakana okayale nda Ponto, la nda Galatia, la nda Kapadokia, la nda Asia la nda Bitunia,
english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, 1:1 to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

lokele: ebaaomoko ko la liluwani lia oso lia Mungu Sango, ebüchomoko ko la Bolimo, litina mbo oliteseke la mbo ɔmɛmyakɔmɔkɔ la bakilaba Yesu Masiya. Booto la lilatemi biulweke end’ino!
english: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

lokele: Lɔkɛmɔ loyaleke ende Mungu ako Sango wa Ngɛnɛ wasu, Yesu Masiya! Ko l’eoka ya shota shande sifi, aotak’iso liasi la iɛli siyai ko la litɛmwi lia Yesu Masiya nda liwa,
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

lokele: la mbo ɔɔlɛkɛ botiko ebotilasɛɛsɛlɛ, ebotiabebe, ebotiabɛɛlɛk’imɔ la ebosoisoelomo ino nda Use,
english: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

lokele: ako ino ebasotekamesomo ko la bofoka wa Mungu la lilendelu lianu mbo bɔɔlɛkɛ liuwesi elisotaumbakela ndoisokolomo nda mbile ya liko. Bakoteli bawau basamboya
english: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

lokele: Nda loasɔ-lo otoyaimwa yai nde kwani ko mbile ɛmɔi eluwa lole lanu ndokaka biale ya bakoteli ba bɔfɔnɔ la bɔfɔnɔ,
english: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

lokele: mbo likoteli lia lilendelu lianu elisolongela mbela la loketi lofi la elisokotelomo imɔ ko la bösä ani etosɛɛsɛlɛ, liao liko lilendelu lianu lieshelek’ino loomalo la tala la lɔkɛmɔ nda lɔɛnɛsɔ loa Yesu Masiya.
english: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

lokele: Otiɛn’Inde, nde ososam’Inde; ambo kwani boitɔɛn’Inde, nde osolendelo ko Inde, la otoyaimwa la limɛngɔ elisolongela baoi angɛnɛ la elisoilakama la tala;
english: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

lokele: ongoma tuu ya lilendelu lianu yende mbo osɔɔlɔ liuwesi lia belimo yanu. Liuwesi lifi lisamboya
english: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

lokele: Batɔndɔli ebatɔndɔɛlɛkɛ ino loasɔ loa booto ebokayeke end’ino, balukaka la bafelaka liuwesi-li;
english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

lokele: bafelakaka mbo ndai la eni mbile eyanangolaka Bolimo wa Masiya nda betema yau, ani atɔndɔlɔ̈kɔ̈ Inde biale ebikokeke Masiya la tala ebikayeke mbisa ya yao.
english: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

lokele: Lɔɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ end’iyo mbo bakelaka ongoma, inga ndosung’iyo angɛnɛ, kangä ko ino, nda njasɔ ebisokambesomo ino kwani ko l’ebasonangoel’ino Mboli Ilau ko la Bolimo Botanu oyatomomu konda Use oya end’ino; la bakitomo bende la yɛmɛ yotichaka imɔ ko njasɔ-ao. Bakakanelo eoka ya lilitesi
english: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

lokele: Eokao wangemesaka bienyelo yanu, taka betema yanu se, kɛsɛkɛ iɛli shanu fwaa ko nda bootaota ebokaeshelomoko end’ino nda bayelo ba Yesu Masiya.
english: Therefore prepare your minds for action. 1:13 Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

lokele: Yalaka kwa bana ba lilitesi, otutelëk’imɔ yɛmɛ ya bindo kwa akelak’ino nda mbile ya botutuku wanu;
english: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

lokele: kongo ko kwa eyalak’Inde oyatak’ino lioi ko Botanu, ino imɔ yalaka batanu nda beyaeli yanu bitotina,
english: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,

lokele: eoka losotomo nda Lokasa mbo— Yalakaka batanu eoka Imi yende botanu.
english: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.” Leviticus 11:44-45

lokele: Eya to mbo ososingwakel’Inde kwa Sango, ako Inde oyatoataka boto la boto eloande loasɔ ko la liengani, ino koyalaka la lilitesi lia bɔwa ko la mbile ebisolimel’ino ono;
english: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

lokele: oluwi nde mbo waendolomoko nda biyaelo ya boyalaala ebisosangol’ino ende batata banu, otiaendolomoko la bieto ebitosɛɛsɛlɛ kwa falata la mbela,
english: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

lokele: kangä la bakila ba Masiya ebale la loketi lofi finɛ, ebale kwa eba efembeli ya bɔkɔkɔ eyeti la limɛmɛ, l’angwɛnɛ litwanelo.
english: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

lokele: Inde nd’aomokö oso wa bakeelomo ba wenda, nde asɔɛnɛsɔmɔ ko kwani nda bacho ba liko ko l’eoka yanu;
english: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

lokele: ako ino ebatoimela Mungu ko l’eoka yande. Mungu nd’atɛmɔlɔkɔ Inde nda liwa la ataliak’Inde tala, mbo liimeli la iɛli shanu biyaleke ngo ko ende Mungu.
english: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

lokele: Ani asotanes’ino belimo yanu ko la lilitesi lia wewe ko mbo osamanakeke la losamɔ loa bitungani elole la momongo, ongoma samakanaka to la botema bototi.
english: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,

lokele: Osootomo liasi, inga la koto ebitosɛɛsɛlɛ, kangä ko la yao ebiitosɛɛselɛ imɔ, ko l’eoka ya Lioi lia Mungu elitoyala la liwawi ko nda lokato;
english: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

lokele: eoka mbo— Bindo ya balomboki batotina yende kwa bangala ba elanga, La wano wa yao kwa fɔtɔtɔ ya elanga; Bangala batobɛɛlɛ, la fɔtɔtɔ bitokwaka se,
english: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

lokele: Kongo ko Lioi lia Mungu litotikala ko layalaya. Liende ko wɛndi ebosonangoelomo ino nda Mboli Ilau. 2
english: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” Isaiah 40:6-8 This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

lokele: Eokao sɛnyanaka la bobe wa bɛfɔnɔ bitoti la belimbakeli bitoti, la nanga, la funo la basɛɔli batoti;
english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

lokele: kwa atofumbaka banaoli, ino fumbaka ko ongoma ndɔɔlɔ baɛlɛ ba njasɔ ya bolimo, mbo okondeke ko la bao nda liuwesi,
english: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

lokele: ani osotalɛtɛ mbo Ngɛnɛ wasu ale la booto. Boyaeli wa Bofindi wa Mungu boko Etanda
english: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

lokele: Yauku to end’Inde, ako litalɛ elile la liwawi, elisofekomo la bato, nde nda baiso ba Mungu lisoaomo la lisolitesomo;
english: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

lokele: ino angɛnɛ imɔ yalaka batalɛ ebale la liwawi, ebatoswomo la ndakɔ ya bolimo, mbo ino boyaleke botükä wa Kanga ebiüehomu ndotambaka bafaefi ba betema ebengani ndoaelomo la Mungu ko l’eoka ya Yesu Masiya.
english: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

lokele: Losotomo to nda lokasa mbo— Tɛnɛ ngo, nda Siona isoswa litalɛ lia ikululu, Elisoaomo la elisolitesomo la boto oyatolendelo Inde aitokesomo sɔni!
english: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, 2:6 I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.” Isaiah 28:16

lokele: Eokao, end’ino ebasolendelo Inde ale lɔkɛmɔ, nde ende ebaitolendelo, ale Litalɛ elisofekelomo la baswi, Nde liao lisoswomo nda botö wa ndakɔ.
english: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,” Psalms 118:22

lokele: La mbo— Litalɛ liokwes’ato tolango la litalɛ liowaka bakulya; ebaitolitesa wɛndi eoka batokwa tolango, kwa akomyomoko ko oso.
english: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” Isaiah 8:14 For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

lokele: Nde ino wende balomboki ebasoaomo, botükä wa Kanga ya Bɔkɔta, tukela ya bato ebüchomu, la bato ebasoomana la Mungu kongo, mbo oteke boekï wa tolombo etwakelak’Inde oyatak’ino lioi liosekwa nda lilima oyaɔtɔkɔ nda eloande löwa lomwaalomo.
english: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

lokele: Oso otiaaka bofindi wa bato, nde kwani wende bofindi wa Mungu; oso otiaɔlɔkɔ shota, nde kwani osɔɔlɔ shota. Boyaeli wa bato ba Mungu nda baiso ba bato
english: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

lokele: Basamomu, isoombak’ino ebayali kwa bato ebasolimela la bɛɛnda nda wenda-bo, mbo ofekeke yɛmɛ ya bindo ebitonana bita la belimo yanu.
english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

lokele: Yalakaka la boyaeli bolau sisi ya bato ba wenda, litina mbo, atosɛɔlɔ iyo osɛɔl’ino, mbo wende ebatokelaka obe, bɛnɛkɛ ko bekeeli ilau la beineleke ko Mungu nda lise elikayek’Inde end’iyo.
english: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

lokele: Litesaka baiti batotina bau ebale l’isosha ende bato, eoka ya Ngɛnɛ wasu; ango ende Bɔkɔta oyalongeli,
english: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

lokele: ango ende Bekumi ebasotomomo lande ndokucha ebatokelaka obe, la ndoomalesa ebatokelaka olau.
english: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

lokele: Eoka ongoma lisangi lia Mungu lile mbo bekeeli yanu bilau biyaleseke bato ba bibebe ko tau ani atoongak’iyo baoi ba botutuku.
english: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

lokele: Kwa ayal’ino toote, otangëke mbo iote shanu sile ko fofe yokelaka bobe, kongo ko yalaka bɛkɔwa ya Mungu.
english: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

lokele: Litesaka bato batotina, samaka beoto ya Etanda, wangaka Mungu angɛnɛ, litesaka Bɔkɔta oyalongeli! Bakuwi
english: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

lokele: Bakuwi, litesaka bangɛnɛ banu la bɔwa finɛ, inga ko ebale la olau la bɔfɔu kongo, kangä imɔ ko ebakokelak’ino efinole.
english: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

lokele: Eoka eya to mbo boto oyaenyeli nde Mungu, etendela ndoka wale ko l’angwɛnɛ litina, ongoma inde koomalesa Mungu;
english: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

lokele: ¿Nde bokela obe, l’aɛ koomakomo mbaka, botendela la bɔfɔu, otɔɔlɔ loni to lokuku? Kongo ko, bokelaka bolau, l’aɛ kookesomoko wale, botendela wao la olau, ani otoomalesa nde Mungu.
english: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

lokele: Eoka otomu nde lioi ko la litina-li, mbo Masiya looka wale ko l’eoka yanu, ongoma Inde lotikel’ino etichelo mbo otuteleke banyata bande.
english: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you 2:21 an example, that you should follow his steps,

lokele: Atiakelaka loasɔ lobe, la limutoli lia bolimbake litiaokomoko nda bɔnɔkɔ wande;
english: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.” Isaiah 53:9

lokele: amɔlɔkɔmɔkɔ Inde, atiamutolaka la limɔli, okekesomoko Inde biale, atiatak’iyo nganyä, nde Inde lomacha loasɔ ko ende Mungu oyatoataka loao ko la liengani.
english: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

lokele: Inde angɛnɛ atolaka batwanelo nda bindo yande nda isandu sha lieka, mbo toweleke batwanelo basu la mbo toikeke ko la liengani.
english: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds. 2:24

lokele: Ko la bakambile bande, ino nd’asosäsesomo säsosäso. Eoka ino nd’alotalotaka kwa bɛkɔkɔ, nde kwani osoinwaka ende Botingani la Bokuki wa belimo yanu.
english: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer 2:25 of your souls.

lokele: Ongoma ino bali, litesaka balome banu angɛnɛ, litina mbo, eya mbo bamɔi batiimele Lioi lia Ngɛnɛ, limɔ iyo kɔɔsɔmɔ, inga la baoi, kangä ko la boyaeli wa bali bau,
english: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

lokele: ani atɔɛnɛkɛ batolome limama la boyaeli wanu botanu.
english: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

lokele: Bɔfɛkɔ wanu boyalëke to ko wao ebole lousa, boko swee ya belowa, la lilɛngɔ lia mbela, la liwati lia bisinda ya bɔfɛkɔ kongo;
english: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

lokele: kangä bɔfɛkɔ eboisami nda botema wa boto, lilɛngɔ elitilasɛɛsɛlɛkɛ liko botema sambo la bɔfɔu, ebole la loketi lofi fafo nda baiso ba Mungu.
english: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

lokele: Eoka batomali ba kwaala lokɛsɛkɛlɛ iɛli shau ko ende Mungu, bawataka bɔfɛkɔ ongoma la balitesaka batolome bau,
english: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

lokele: kwa Sala alitesaka Abalayama, inde lotang’inde mbo— Ngɛnɛ wami; l’ani atokelak’ino ko bolau, wende bana bande nde owangeke iwaesa ango simɔi.
english: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

lokele: Ino batolome ko ongoma, yalanaka la bali banu la wɛlï ani otoenyela mbo botomali atiengane otolome la bofoka, eoka ino lau osowachana ndosangola bootaota wa loiko mbo basomboli banu batakufesomo.
english: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

lokele: Lioi lia tuu ko mbo, yalanaka la botema ɔmwito, okelanaka ngandi, samanaka la beoto ya Etanda, la shota la liikami se.
english: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

lokele: Otakundanëke bobe ko la bosakane, angoko limɔli eoka ya limɔli, kangä la lifotesi lia lɔkɛmɔ, eoka watomoko lioi ko la litina-li mbo osangoleke lioi lia lɔkɛmɔ.
english: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

lokele: Eoka, inde oyalɛmbi ko ndosama liwawi-li la ndɔɛnɛ bacho balau, Akufeseke lolamɛ loande lotaonga bobe, la bɔnɔkɔ nda bɔlɔwane;
english: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.

lokele: Aloteke mboka ya obe, akeleke ko olau, Alukeke lilatemi ko ndotutaka liao.
english: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

lokele: Eoka baiso ba Mungu basowɛlɛ eba liengani bonono, Batoi bande batolaila basomboli bau Nde bɔmbɔ wa Ngɛnɛ bole la wuno ani atoticha ebatokelaka bobe. Likongolomu loasɔ loa Liengani
english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.” Psalms 34:12-16

lokele: ¿Ndai kokeel’ino obe eyambo bofumbaka ndokela olau?
english: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

lokele: Kongo ko bookaka wale loasɔ loa liengani, ambo wende la limɛngɔ fuu! Owangëke iyo, otatemëke;
english: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.” Isaiah 8:12

lokele: Uchaka Masiya kwa Ngɛnɛ wa betema yanu. Yalakaka la baoi ba limutoli liomutoela boto oyatofelak’ino litina lia iɛli esile lanu, kongo ko mutolaka ko la liikami se la lilitesi;
english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

lokele: elembeelo ya njasɔ eyaleke ko la botanu, litina mbo eyekamɔlɔmɔkɔ ino, ebatotɔngɔkɔ boyaeli wanu olau wa Masiya, kofakomo ngo ko sɔni.
english: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

lokele: Losolongela bolau mbo ino wokeke wale ko eoka yokelaka olau, eya to mbo Mungu esanga ongoma, inga to eoka yokelaka bobe.
english: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

lokele: Eoka Masiya awaka loasɔ loa batwanelo ba bato, ko liwa limɔi, ewa liengani awelaka ebati la liao, mbo aeshelek’iso ende Mungu; aolomoko nda boyaeli wa bolomboki, afaefomoko loiko la Bolimo.
english: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

lokele: Ko la Bolimo akɛkɛ okanangoela belimo nda ekandelo,
english: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

lokele: bako ebatefolaka lioi lia Mungu kwaala nda mbile eyaumwaka Mungu ndoumbakela angowa esole nda bacho ba Noa eyakelomokö watɔ wa liuwesi, nda wao ko bamyɔ kongo, bako bato bonanɛi, bauwesomoko la balia.
english: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

lokele: Loende ikweelo sha lilufi elitouwes’ino kwani, inga lisooli lia lilo lia bindo, kangä tele ya elembeelo elau ende Mungu, ko l’eoka ya litɛmwi lia Yesu Masiya nda liwa,
english: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

lokele: oyakɛkɛ nda Use, oyayali kwani nda bosamba w’olome wa Mungu, omao ko bakitomo la tososha la befoka bitotina bisokakalesomo kakala ko lande.
english: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

lokele: Eoka mbo Yesu okaka biale nda bindo, wangemesaka betema yanu ko la lienyeli-li mbo oyasokaka biale nda bindo asomacha batwanelo,
english: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

lokele: litina mbo, ko la mbile ebisotikala, boyaeli boitofɔɔlɔmɔ ko la yɛmɛ ya boto, kangä la lisangi lia Mungu.
english: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

lokele: Mbile eyesoeta yaɔlɛsɛk’ino fofe yokelaka kwa ebilɛmbi bato ba wenda, biko ndokwa nda mboka ya bolëfë la yɛmɛ ya obe, liwa lia bänä, bisha ibe, limwi lia bänä la lisemoli lia bɛfɔnɔ ya mungu elisofekomo la bikela.
english: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

lokele: Basomwaala kɔni eoka oitowatemana lau nda toongo twa sheteseli, limɔ basomɔlɔk’ino;
english: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.

lokele: nde batoaolela loasɔ-lo end’Inde oyakoengani ndoatel’iyo, l’ebakoyali la liwawi l’ebasowa imɔ.
english: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

lokele: Ko la litina-li, Mboli Ilau yanangolomoko ango ende ebawakä, mbo kwa asoatelomo iyo njasɔ kwa balomboki, belimo yau biyaleke la loiko kwa Mungu. Bakoteli la Bifembi ya liko bisamboya
english: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

lokele: Nde tuu ya bitotina bisoya tina; eokao taka betema yanu se la sombokolaka la baenyeli ebatani la wɛlï.
english: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

lokele: Loasɔ elosolongela, lole ngo ko ndokɔkɔmɔ nda lisamakani, eoka losamɔ lotoliaka ambɔlɛ wa batwanelo.
english: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

lokele: Nyangelaka bɛɛnda angokimakima;
english: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

lokele: bafi ebasofaefomo ino, boto la boto, kaelanaka bao kwa basungi balau bokaela bɔfɔnɔ la bɔfɔnɔ wa booto wa Mungu.
english: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

lokele: Boto enangola, ambo ko baölo ba Mungu; boto eyala bosungi nda likuwa, ambo ko la bofoka ebotɔɔlɛsɛ Mungu end’inde, litina mbo nda bitoti-bi Mungu ataliomoko tala ko la Yesu Masiya. Tala la isosha shokakalesa bile yande ko layalaya. Ongoma.
english: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

lokele: Basamomu, omwaalëke loasɔ loa likoteli elile kwa bösä elisoyakotel’ino kwa mbo loasɔ elotiluwane losoyel’ino,
english: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

lokele: nde okaka ko limɛngɔ eoka anyo ososangana nda lioki lia biale ya Masiya, mbo nda lɔɛnɛsɔ loa tala yande, ino bokaka imɔ ko limɛngɔ la linɛngina.
english: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

lokele: Bomɔlɔkɔmɔ eoka ya lina lia Masiya, wende la limɛngɔ, eoka tala la bolimo wa Mungu bisoelama end’ino.
english: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

lokele: Nde boto angɔmɔi wanu ataoka wale mbo ale booli wa boto, ango ko wiya, ango oyatokelaka obe, ango italaila.
english: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

lokele: Kongo ko boto eoka wale ko l’eoka mbo ale wa Masiya, okëke sɔni, nde aineleke tala ya Mungu ko nda e-lina-li.
english: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

lokele: Eoka mbile esoya elikakoleke liataki lia njasɔ ya bofindi wa Mungu; la eya mbo liakola end’iso, tuu ya loasɔ loa ebatotefokola Mboli Ilau ya Mungu koyala to moni?
english: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

lokele: ¿Ango ewa liengani euwa ko la tale, ambo oyatiluwe Mungu la ewa batwanelo kotɛmwa anima to?
english: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?” Proverbs 11:31

lokele: Eokao ebatokaka wale ko l’eoka ya lisangi lia Mungu, bateke belimo yau ko la bekeeli bilau, ko nda besamba ya Bokeli Wolendelomo.
english: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

lokele: Ino biange ya Etanda, imi oyale imɔ ko wange la ɔmɔi oyɛnɛkɛ biale ya Masiya la oyatosangana lanu imɔ nda tala eyekɛnɛsɔmɔkɔ, isolɔmbɔkɔl’ino mbo—
english: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

lokele: Kukyaka liyasa lia Mungu eliyali lanu, komyaka liao, inga eoka osotinjakomo, kanga mbo osolɛmbɛ ndokela lisangi lia Mungu; inga la yɛmɛ ya bieto, kangä la botema wa mengi;
english: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

lokele: inga kwa bangɛnɛ ba botiko ebosofomo ino, kangä kwa bitichelo ende liyasa lianu.
english: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

lokele: Limɔ akɛnɛlɛkɛ Botingani Wolongela, ino kɔɔlɔ boyoyo wa tala ebotilabɛɛlɛkɛ.
english: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

lokele: Ino tosenge imɔ, litesaka biange; ino yaatotina, wataka liikami se kwa bisinda ya likuwa lianu, eoka mbo— Mungu atofekela eba bɛmɛtɔ, nde atofaekefa eba liɔndwi se ko booto wande.
english: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” Proverbs 3:34

lokele: Eokao ɔndwaka se hɔndwa nda bosamba wa bofoka wa Mungu mbo ataliek’ino la mbile yoengana;
english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

lokele: umbolaka tɔkɛnɛnɛ twanu ende Mungu eoka Inde nd’asotakela ino bolenda.
english: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

lokele: Taka betema yanu se, lambaka! Wiyani lanu ako Satana atotimbatimba okaluke boto wola.
english: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

lokele: Fekelaka inde, nanaka lande ko la liimeli elisokɔkɔmɔ kɔkɛ, ani asoluw’ino mbo beoto yanu nda wenda-bo basokaka imɔ ko bifembi kwa ino.
english: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

lokele: Mungu, Ngɛnɛ wa booto bototina, oyasot’ino lioi mbo ɔɔtɛkɛ nda tala yande ko la Masiya konda layalaka, mbisa ani asokaka biale ko mbile sinyo, Inde angɛnɛ eɔlɔl’ino, ekɔkɔmɛsek’ino, ewangemesak’ino, efaefak’ino bofoka!
english: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

lokele: Ende Inde isosha shokakalesa ko layalaya! Ongoma.
english: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

lokele: Isosɔnɛl’ino lokasa sumbu lɔkɛkɛ ko la bosamba wa Silwano, etungani yolendelomo (kwa atangi nde’mi), isofumbes’ino la isoekekes’ino mbo njasɔ-bi yende ya booto wa wewe wa Mungu; kɔkɔmɔkɔ nda wao kɔkɛ!
english: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

lokele: Eb’Etanda ya Babilona, ebasoaomo kwani ayali ino, basoseel’ino; la Malako wana wami ko ongoma.
english: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

lokele: Lamolanaka la tɔchɔu twa losamɔ etüchomu. Lilatemi end’ino yaatotina ebawatemani la Masiya!
english: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
